The existing feedback classified both JSON syntax failures and valid-JSON envelope failures under PlanDecode(InvalidJson), without explicitly saying that calls must be the direct top-level field.

The next four responses repeated one identical valid JSON object whose only top-level field was arguments; each was correctly rejected with zero side effects but the feedback did not distinguish this contract error from syntax failure.
Responses 6 through 8 restored the direct calls shape, initialized the Map, read the workspace, and reproduced the test failure.
The eight-request limit ended the run before the Agent could apply the already identified one-line fix.
